title: YouTube, The Great Radicalizer? Auditing and Mitigating Ideological Biases in YouTube Recommendations
reasoning: The paper focuses on auditing and mitigating ideological (political) bias and radicalization within YouTube's recommendation algorithms. It does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral systems, or ethical frameworks as part of its core methodology.
